zh.title: 法航 La Compagnie 開辦 杜塞爾多夫 紐約 直飛
zh.summary: LaCompagnie宣布2027年春季開辦杜塞爾多福至紐約直飛每周最多五班
body: 法航 La Compagnie 於 2026 年 9 月 7 日宣布，將於 2027 年春季開辦 杜塞爾多夫 (DUS) 至 紐約 紐華克 (EWR) 直飛航線，每周最多五班。
新航線 將由 空中巴士 A321LR 執飛 2027 年 引進 一架 2028 年 再引進 A321XLR 根據 ch-aviation 數據 該 航空 公司 目前 擁有 兩架 A321LR。
目前 La Compagnie 已連結 紐約 紐華克 至 巴黎 奧利 (ORY) 尼斯 (NCE) 及 米蘭 馬爾彭薩 (MXP) 行政總裁 Christian Vernet 指出 杜塞爾多夫 為 歐洲 重要 經濟 中心 適合 全商務艙 模式。

en.title: La Compagnie Adds Düsseldorf–Newark Route Starting Spring 2027
en.summary: La Compagnie announces Düsseldorf–Newark service from spring 2027, up to five weekly flights
body: La Compagnie announced on 7 September 2026 that it will launch a nonstop route between Düsseldorf (DUS) and New York Newark (EWR) in spring 2027, operating up to five flights per week.
The expansion will be supported by an Airbus A321LR arriving in 2027 and an Airbus A321XLR in 2028; ch-aviation data shows the carrier currently operates two A321LR aircraft.

La Compagnie presently links Newark with Paris Orly (ORY), Nice (NCE) and Milan Malpensa (MXP); Chief Executive Christian Vernet said Düsseldorf is a major European economic centre suited to the airline’s all‑business‑class model.

sources.name: AeroTime — La Compagnie adds Düsseldorf-New York to its strictly busin…

facts.claim: La Compagnie will launch a nonstop route from Düsseldorf Airport (DUS) to Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) starting Spring 2027.
facts.sourceQuote: La Compagnie has added a route from Düsseldorf Airport (DUS) to New York’s Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) to its strictly business class network, beginning in Spring 2027.

facts.claim: The new service will operate up to five flights per week.
facts.sourceQuote: On September 7, 2026, the French boutique airline announced that its new nonstop service, bridging Europe and the US, would operate up to five times a week.

facts.claim: La Compagnie claims it will be the only airline offering direct flights between Newark and Düsseldorf when the service begins.
facts.sourceQuote: According to La Compagnie , when the service begins in 2027, it will be the only airline to offer direct flights between Newark and Düsseldorf.

facts.claim: The route expansion will be supported by an Airbus A321LR arriving in 2027 and an Airbus A321XLR arriving in 2028.
facts.sourceQuote: La Compagnie’s route expansion will be supported by the arrival of an Airbus A321LR (Long Range) in 2027, followed by an Airbus A321XLR during 2028.

facts.claim: ch-aviation data indicates La Compagnie currently operates two Airbus A321LR aircraft.
facts.sourceQuote: According to ch-aviation data, La Compagnie currently operates two Airbus A321LR aircraft.

facts.claim: Currently La Compagnie connects Newark with Paris Orly (ORY), Nice Côte d’Azur (NCE) and Milan Malpensa (MXP).
facts.sourceQuote: At present, the airline connects Newark with Paris Orly (ORY), Nice Côte d’Azur (NCE) and Milan Malpensa (MXP).
